title: Require independently matched objects before certifying picture-label agreement
statement: Adding a label comparison after label-led pairing preserves false perfect agreement with fully rotated labels. On f68r1 image coordinates, label-blind physical pairing reveals all 28 permuted links and separates missing evidence from disagreement.
check: First require two positions in a common folio and canvas frame and freeze a correspondence before reading label claims. Confirm a same-folio unique L-unit locus only when both independent physical annotations support it. Distinguish verified, guessed by order or angle, explicitly absent, missing and disputed claims. Separate visual-feature agreement and label-link coverage, and restrict downstream textual tests and shuffles to the same frozen eligible link set. Reproduce the attached swap, removal, permutation, and coordinate-offset controls before any live change.

finding: On 28 independently agreed f68r1 star locations, the published appearance scorer and adding a new label item after its current pairing both return 1.0 after a full cyclic label permutation. The original pairing matched zero correct physical objects in that control. Pairing by physical centers first detects 28 conflicts without losing a physical match.

Erasing every second-reader label gives 1.0 in the current implementation and 0.80 with the proposed agreement item, still at the existing threshold. The independent physical matches expose 28 one-sided missing entries. When both annotations are blank, appearance agreement remains 1.0 and no label agreement statistic is supported.

Shuffling the object roster with labels unchanged preserves all 28 confirmed geometrical links. A small coordinate offset retains 28 independently matched links. A 100px offset on each axis yields zero pairs under the frozen tolerance, explicitly marking the correspondence unresolved.

The current DSL already uses count of distinct explicit labels as an annotation tie-break. f68r1 has legacy annotations with positions and no labels, alongside labelled draft readings whose label assignments are partly guessed by order. Counts of available source fields and quantified controls are attached. This calls for a separate label-evidence table tied to independently determined physical objects.

contract.page_identity: Same folio, common canvas, and declared coordinate frame and anchor type.
contract.pairing: Use independent positions and report unresolved candidates. Keep the properties used for matching out of scored appearance features.
contract.label_status: Record verified, guessed, explicitly absent, missing, and disputed distinctly. Certify only unique same-folio L-unit agreement with independent evidence.
contract.downstream: Fix verified links and mutually agreed closed-vocabulary appearance features before reading label words. Use those same eligible records in the observed statistic and every shuffle.

frozen_plan.source: PR 799's frozen f68r1 image-only measurements. Use the 28 unique certain concordant stars, leaving one ambiguous word boundary outside the primary control.
frozen_plan.original_pairing: Replay current vs/pictures.py unchanged. Deliberately give both seats the same five fictional shared features so that physically wrong pairings of visually similar objects can be detected only by label evidence.
frozen_plan.patch_comparison: Also add one label item for pairs where one or both seats provide a label, while retaining the published pairing. Equal populated labels count agreement and missing on one side counts disagreement.
frozen_plan.coordinate_method: In a common Yale canvas, match reciprocal nearest physical star centers within 60 native pixels before considering labels. A matched single missing label is discordance. Double missing means unavailable evidence. Unmatched centers are reported separately as insufficient correspondence, regardless of how many labels were transcribed. Do not reuse nearest candidates or use labels to tie-break.
controls: true two-reader pairings with same labels, and shuffled object order
one missing label in the second seat, half missing, all missing, and both seats blank
swap two labels, and cyclic rotation of labels among all stars
fixed common-canvas perturbations of +20 x / -10 y and then +100 x / +100 y in the second reader coordinates
frozen_plan.outcomes: Record old appearance agreement and old label-based pairing's physical match count. Separately record compared label slots, consensual labels, conflicting labels, one-sided and two-sided absence, and unpaired geometry. No actual agreement status is changed.

minimal_synthetic_counterexample.setup: Four identical stars in one ring at 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees. Seat B's object list is reversed throughout.
minimal_synthetic_counterexample.scope: Exact angle matching is unambiguous in this fixture. Geometry verification on real annotations must separately enforce a common frame, trustworthy positions, and support when some objects cannot be matched.
